### U.S. Defense Manufacturer IEH Targeted by Phishing Attack
<span class="imp imp-3" title="Importance 3/5" aria-label="Importance 3 of 5"><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i></i><i></i></span> Defense and aerospace supplier IEH Corporation disclosed a phishing attack that compromised an employee's Microsoft 365 mailbox and potentially exposed export-controlled military technical data, though the company found no evidence of exfiltration.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Attacker posed as a business contact, used fake Microsoft login page to harvest credentials</li>
<li>Unauthorized access occurred August 4-6, 2026</li>
<li>Exposed data included purchase orders, engineering documents, customer communications</li>
<li>IEH filed Form 8-K with SEC on August 7, 2026; does not expect material impact</li>
</ul>

Sources: [The Register](https://www.theregister.com/security/2026/08/07/ieh-corp-says-phished-staffer-opened-gates-to-company-m365/5284523) <span class="src-badge src-research">Research</span>, [Security Affairs](https://news.google.?oc=5) <span class="src-badge src-rss">RSS</span>
